paragraphs: In [Eruvin 29a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.29a.9), Gursak bar Dari spoke in the name of [Rav Menasheya bar Shegovli](https://www.girsology.com/toledot?entry=h-139997eb019b7081&lang=en), who spoke in the name of Rav.[^1]

notes.text: The linked line gives two successive transmitters. The internal link opens Hyman’s separate Shegovli notice.
